scenes.topic_description:
Situation: You arrive at a dental clinic in Poland with tooth pain and need to check in before seeing anyone. It is your first time in this country and likely your first visit to this clinic, so the front desk decides whether you can be seen today and what paperwork is needed.
Learner: Patient. Partner: Receptionist.
Not in this scene: describing the pain in detail, the examination, treatment options, medicine, aftercare.

say why you are here — slot: the problem
answer whether you have been here before — slot: the last visit (never, once)
ask whether the dentist can see you today — slot: none
ask how long the wait is — slot: none
answer whether you have insurance — slot: the type of insurance
ask what document they need — slot: the document type
must_understand: asks for your name and why you are here
asks whether this is your first visit
offers a time today or says you need to wait
asks whether you have insurance
tells you what document to show and where to wait

scenes.topic_description:
Situation: You are now in the dentist's room for the main consultation. The dentist needs a simple description of the tooth problem and then decides what treatment to do. Because this is your first time in Poland, clear understanding of the diagnosis and basic aftercare matters most.
Learner: Patient. Partner: Dentist.
Not in this scene: check-in details, insurance, documents, waiting time, payment at reception.
